interpretation.en: Read as: conversion rate, by device, 25 Sep–22 Oct 2026.
interpretation.tr: Soru şöyle okundu: dönüşüm oranı, cihaza göre, 25 Eyl–22 Eki 2026.

query.sql:
-- metric conversion_rate v2
SELECT
  device,
  SUM(orders) AS numerator,
  SUM(sessions) AS denominator,
  SUM(orders) / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY device
ORDER BY value DESC

comparison.sql:
-- metric conversion_rate v2
SELECT
  device,
  SUM(orders) AS numerator,
  SUM(sessions) AS denominator,
  SUM(orders) / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-28' AND DATE '2026-09-24'
GROUP BY device
ORDER BY value DESC
